title: 第六章 怎么可以真的对夏暮动情？
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

其实，刚走到楼下，薄璟琛就后悔了。

他也不知道自己中了什么该死的邪。

半小时前，许卿打完电话后支支吾吾，说通知了夏暮。

他破天荒地来医院门口，透透气。

站在台阶上，夜风裹着消毒水的气味灌进薄璟琛领口。

他点了根烟，没抽，就夹在指间看它烧。

烟灰被风吹散，落在皮鞋尖上，他也干脆懒得弹。

不对劲，真的不对劲。

是因为那荒谬的潜意识幻觉吗？听见夏暮名字的时候，他竟然下意识地，想提前见到她。

啧，看来他真的病得不轻。

薄家的二公子，怎么可以真的对夏暮动情？

他越想越烦，随手把烟掐灭，碾在垃圾桶上的沙石盘里。

刚想起身离开，抬头，却撞进了一双带着错愕的杏眸里。

夏暮从一辆黑色库里南上下来。

她穿了一件领口略高的薄衫，夜风掀动她的发尾。

有凌乱的碎发，扫过她的脸颊，给她本就清瘦的小脸，增添了几分破碎感。

只远远地看她一眼，脑子里那些画面回忆，瞬间又涌了上来——

夏暮主动与他凑近，秾长的眼睫垂落。

贴上来的唇瓣，触感绵软。

跟眼前这个眼神平静淡漠，向来古板无趣的夏暮，判若两人。

薄景琛喉结不自觉地滚了一下，耳后根发烫。

自己真的需要加大脑部CT的扫描范围。

可能是有肿瘤。压迫了某根负责分辨幻觉与现实的神经。

他下意识别开视线，落在她身后的黑色轿车上。

车门开合只是一瞬，他没来得及看清驾驶座上的人。

只是......这台车看起来，似乎有点眼熟。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In fact, as soon as he walked downstairs, Bo Jingchen regretted it.

He didn't know what damn evil had fallen upon him.

Half an hour ago, Xu Qing hesitated after making a phone call and said that he had informed Xia Mu.

For the first time, he came to the hospital entrance to get some fresh air.

Standing on the steps, the night wind filled with the smell of disinfectant filled Bo Jingchen's collar.

He lit a cigarette, but without smoking it, he held it between his fingers and watched it burn.

The cigarette ashes were blown away by the wind and landed on the tips of his leather shoes, but he simply didn't bother to flick them.

Something's wrong, something really isn't right.

Is it because of that ridiculous subconscious hallucination?When he heard Xia Mu's name, he subconsciously wanted to see her in advance.

Gee, it seems that he is really ill.

How could the second son of the Bo family really be in love with Xia Mu?

The more he thought about it, the more annoyed he became. He put out the cigarette and crushed it into the gravel plate on the trash can.

Just as he was about to get up and leave, he looked up and met a pair of astonished almond-shaped eyes.

Xia Mu got off a black Cullinan.

She wore a thin shirt with a slightly high collar, and the night wind stirred the ends of her hair.

There were messy broken hair that swept across her cheeks, adding a sense of fragmentation to her already thin face.

Just looking at her from a distance, those pictures and memories in my mind suddenly came back to me——

Xia Mu took the initiative to get closer to him, her long eyelashes drooping.

The lips pressed against her felt soft.

He was completely different from the Xia Mu, who had calm and indifferent eyes and was always boring.

Bao Jingchen's Adam's apple rolled unconsciously, and the roots behind his ears felt hot.

I really need to increase the scan range of my brain CT scan.

There may be a tumor.It oppresses a certain nerve responsible for distinguishing illusion from reality.

He subconsciously looked away and landed on the black car behind her.

The door opened and closed for just a moment, and he didn't have time to see clearly the person in the driver's seat.

It's just... this car looks a bit familiar.
